content:
**Corn Soup** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

It is a type of soup that uses corn as its primary ingredient, and shares a model with several other soups.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (1) Corn (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Corn | | Corn Soup (1) | 

- One can be found at the Tyler County Fairgrounds.
- Can be crafted at a Cooking Station after having picked up corn for the first time.
- May be sold by Mr. Waiter at the dining room inside the Whitespring Resort.
- May be found in the Communist Collectron Station, when it is set to run in "Proletariat" mode.
